source.text: tantrasāra, saptadaśam āhnikam vaiṣṇavādidakṣiṇatantrānteṣu śāsaneṣu ye sthitāḥ tadgṛhītavratā vā ye ca uttamaśāsanasthā api anadhikṛtādharaśāsanagurūpasevinaḥ te yadā śaktipātena pārameśvareṇa unmukhīkriyante tadā teṣām ayaṃ vidhiḥ tatra enaṃ kṛtopavāsam anyadine sādhāraṇamantrapūjitasya tadīyāṃ ceṣṭāṃ śrāvitasya bhagavato 'gre praveśayet tatrāsya vrataṃ gṛhītvā ambhasi kṣipet tato 'sau snāyāt tataḥ prokṣya carudantakāṣṭhābhyāṃ saṃskṛtya baddhanetraṃ praveśya sādhāraṇena mantreṇa parameśvarapūjāṃ kārayet // abhts_17.1 tataḥ sādhāraṇamantreṇa śivīkṛte agnau vrataśuddhiṃ kuryāt tanmantrasampuṭaṃ nāma kṛtvā prāyaścittaṃ śodhayāmi iti svāhāntaṃ śataṃ juhuyāt // abhts_17.2 tato 'pi pūrṇāhutiḥ vauṣaḍantena // abhts_17.3 tato vrateśvaram āhūya pūjayitvā tasya śivājñayā akiṃcitkaraḥ tvam asya bhava iti śrāvaṇāṃ kṛtvā taṃ tarpayitvā visṛjya agniṃ visṛjet iti liṅgoddhāraḥ // abhts_17.4 tato 'sya adhivāsādi prāgvat // abhts_17.5 dīkṣā yatheccham // abhts_17.6

l1_text:
## tsa17-p01
Now seventeenth ahnika: for those staying in lower śāstras — Vaiṣṇava and the rest, down to lower tantric ends — or vow-holders, or even those standing in supreme śāstra yet without authority, serving lower-śāstra teachers — when by descent they are turned by the Lord — then for them this course. Therein: him, having done lodging, on another day, of common-mantra-worshipped, his conduct heard, of the Lord before, bring in. Therein his vow taken, in water cast, then he bathes; then having sprinkled, with tooth-stick and rice-cake refined, bound-eyed, bring in. By common mantra, Lord-worship make. (17.1) Then by common mantra, Śiva-made, in fire vow-purity do; that mantra-enclosure-named having made, "I purify" svāhā-ending a hundred offer. (17.2) Then too full-offering with vauṣaḍa-ending. (17.3) Then vow-lord summoned, worshipped, by his command "ineffective you be for him" made heard, him satiated, fire dismissed — thus is liṅgoddhāra. (17.4) Then of him lodging-and-the-rest as before. (17.5) Initiation as wished. (17.6)

## tsa17-p01 — lifting the lower into the Śiva course
The seventeenth chapter turns to those still standing in lower śāstras — Vaiṣṇavas and the rest, down to the lower tantric ends — or vow-holders, or even people in the supreme śāstra who lack authority and serve lower teachers. When descent turns them, this is their course. Lodge them first. Another day: hear their conduct, bring them before the Lord who has been commonly worshipped. Take their vow, cast them in water, bathe them, sprinkle, refine with tooth-stick and rice-cake, blindfold, bring them in. Make Lord-worship by a common mantra. Then by that mantra, Śiva-made fire: vow-purity — a hundred "I purify" offerings, svāhā. Then a full offering, vauṣaḍa-ended. Then summon the vow-lord, worship him, by his command declare "you are ineffective for him," satiate him, dismiss the fire: liṅgoddhāra. Then lodging and the rest as before. Initiation as you wish.

c1.body:
The seventeenth chapter turns to those still standing in lower śāstras — Vaiṣṇavas and the rest, down to the lower tantric ends — or vow-holders, or even people in the supreme śāstra who lack authority and serve lower teachers. When descent turns them, this is their course. Lodge them first. Another day: hear their conduct, bring them before the Lord who has been commonly worshipped. Take their vow, cast them in water, bathe them, sprinkle, refine with tooth-stick and rice-cake, blindfold, bring them in. Make Lord-worship by a common mantra. Then by that mantra, Śiva-made fire: vow-purity — a hundred "I purify" offerings, svāhā. Then a full offering, vauṣaḍa-ended. Then summon the vow-lord, worship him, by his command declare "you are ineffective for him," satiate him, dismiss the fire: liṅgoddhāra. Then lodging and the rest as before. Initiation as you wish.

The passage moves in six steps. (1) Eligibility: lower-śāstra dwellers (Vaiṣṇava etc.) and even supreme-śāstra-standing-without-authority serving lower teachers, when turned by descent, get this course. (2) Lodging done, another day: common-mantra-worshipped, conduct heard, brought before Lord; vow taken, cast in water, bathed, sprinkled, refined with tooth-stick and cake, bound-eyed, brought in; Lord-worship by common mantra. (3) By common mantra, Śiva-made fire: vow-purity — a hundred "I purify," svāhā. (4) Full offering, vauṣaḍa-ended. (5) Vow-lord summoned, worshipped, "ineffective you be for him" declared, satiated, fire dismissed = liṅgoddhāra. (6) Lodging etc. as before; initiation as wished.
c1.terms: liṅgoddhāra (liṅga-lifting), adharāśāsanastha (lower-śāstra dweller), sādhāraṇamantra (common mantra), vrataśuddhi (vow-purity), akiṃcitkara (ineffective).
c1.function: Lifts lower-śāstra initiates into the Śiva course (liṅgoddhāra) without rejecting their prior path.
c1.local_context: A16 (parokṣa) precedes; A17 teaches lower-path lifting; A18 (abhiṣeka) follows.
